import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long N, K;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long[] Power = new long[65];
    static long[][] Res = new long[35][35];
    static long[][][][][] S = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][][] A = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][][] P = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][] Aux = new long[35][35];
    static Pair<Long, Long>[] X = new Pair[105];

    static class Pair<T1, T2> {
        public T1 first;
        public T2 second;
        public Pair(T1 f, T2 s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }

    static void copy(long[][] X, long[][] Y, long n) {
        for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (long j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                X[(int)i][(int)j] = Y[(int)i][(int)j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void Add(long[] x, long y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            x[i] += y;
            if (x[i] >= MOD) {
                x[i] -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    static void mul(long[][] X, long[][] Y, long[][] Z, long n, long m, long p) {
        for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (long j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                Z[(int)i][(int)j] = 0;
                for (long k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    Z[(int)i][(int)j] += (X[(int)i][(int)k] * Y[(int)k][(int)j]) % MOD;
                }
                Z[(int)i][(int)j] %= MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    static void precalcA() {
        for (long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
            for (long i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) {
                A[0][(int)x][(int)i][(int)i] = 1;
            }
            for (long j = 0; j < K + 1; j++) {
                A[0][(int)x][(int)j][(int)x] = 1;
            }
        }
        copy(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1);
        copy(S[0][K - 1], A[0][K - 1], K + 1);
        for (long x = 1; x < K; x++) {
            mul(P[0][(int)x - 1], A[0][(int)x], P[0][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }
        for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--) {
            mul(A[0][(int)x], S[0][(int)x + 1], S[0][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }

        long cnt = 1;
        for (long m = K; m <= N; m *= K, cnt++) {
            for (long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    copy(A[(int)cnt][(int)x], S[(int)cnt - 1][(int)x], K + 1);
                    long[][] AuxTemp = new long[(int)(K + 1)][(int)(K + 1)];
                    mul(A[(int)cnt][(int)x], P[(int)cnt - 1][(int)x - 1], AuxTemp, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                    copy(A[(int)cnt][(int)x], AuxTemp, K + 1);
                } else {
                    copy(A[(int)cnt][(int)x], S[(int)cnt - 1][(int)x], K + 1);
                }
            }
            copy(P[(int)cnt][0], A[(int)cnt][0], K + 1);
            copy(S[(int)cnt][K - 1], A[(int)cnt][K - 1], K + 1);
            for (long x = 1; x < K; x++) {
                mul(P[(int)cnt][(int)x - 1], A[(int)cnt][(int)x], P[(int)cnt][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }
            for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--) {
                mul(A[(int)cnt][(int)x], S[(int)cnt][(int)x + 1], S[(int)cnt][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }
            if (m > N / K) break;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();
        Power[0] = 1;
        int i = 1;
        while (Power[i - 1] <= N / K) {
            Power[i] = Power[i - 1] * K;
            i++;
        }
        int ind = i;
        --ind;
        precalcA();
        long init = N, last = -1, count = -1, ind2 = 0;
        Res[0][(int)K] = 1;

        for (int i2 = ind; i2 >= 0; i2--) {
            while (Power[i2] <= init) {
                long[][] ResTemp = new long[(int)(K + 1)][(int)(K + 1)];
                mul(Res, A[i2][(int)ind2], ResTemp, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                copy(Res, ResTemp, K + 1);
                ind2++;
                if (ind2 == K) ind2 = 0;
                init -= Power[i2];
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i3 = 0; i3 <= K; i3++) {
            ans += Res[0][i3];
        }
        ans %= MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
